# Bo-Young Choi

I am an Associate Professor in the School of Economics & Trade at Kyungpook National University. My primary research field is international trade, with a secondary field in industrial organization.

My work examines trade policy, exchange rates, foreign direct investment, and firm productivity. I received my Ph.D. in Economics from the University of California, Davis in 2013.
